description: Verify that DHCPDISCOVER carries Option 53 (DHCP message type) — every DHCP message must include this option (RFC 2131 §3 MUST)
approach:
[Objective]
Without Option 53, a receiver cannot tell whether a BOOTP-shaped frame is a DISCOVER, OFFER, REQUEST, ACK, NAK, RELEASE, INFORM, or DECLINE. RFC 2131 §3 makes Option 53 mandatory in every DHCP message.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT → wire: DHCPDISCOVER
   • options blob contains Option 53 with value=1 (DISCOVER)   ← key check

[Pass condition]
DISCOVER's options blob contains Option 53.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_message_type_option_absent — Option 53 missing from DISCOVER
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window

verdicts.Fail_timeout: No DUT DHCPDISCOVER within the listen window
